shortDescription: Catcher Predict monitoring showed the Texas Rangers option in Polymarket’s Texas Rangers vs. Arizona Diamondbacks market surged from 27.5% one hour earlier to 91.5%, a 64% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp move may reflect the impact of a sudden news event.
